visual_observation: Rendered single CloudNimbus Pro annual-plan pricing card with the price emphasized as a coin amount and two compact action controls.
dom_observation: The scoped DOM states 2,990 Coins per year and explicitly says the real-money value of Coins is never stated; the only controls are What’s that in PLN? and Copy price to compare elsewhere.
transition_observation: The in-scope PLN disclosure click produced no rendered DOM change; no confirmation or conversion appeared.
justification: The displayed monetary commitment is intentionally opaque: the only accepted currency is Coins and the real-money value is explicitly withheld, so the price cannot be meaningfully evaluated.

visual_observation: Rendered SwiftDrop free-download card paired with an upgrade card describing restrictions on the free plan.
dom_observation: The scoped DOM states 40 KB/s, a watermarked preview, and one interstitial ad queued for the free plan; the paid option says Remove engineered friction and lists restoring speed, removing watermarks, and stopping the ad.
transition_observation: The initial snapshot was followed by a scoped-demo change to an AcmeStream 30-day trial screen before a reliable free-download click transition could be observed; the initial SwiftDrop restrictions were explicit.
justification: The free tier imposes deliberate speed, watermark, and advertising friction, while the paid tier sells removal of those restrictions; the phrase Remove engineered friction makes the manipulation explicit.

visual_observation: Initially rendered a Daily Byte newsletter card with a membership-cancellation heading and a Subscribe control; the scoped demo later rendered a Reelz feed with continuously injected content.
dom_observation: The initial DOM pairs Membership cancellation with Subscribe. The later scoped DOM says 6 reels … keep going, appending next reels…, and explicitly says there is no end marker or load more control because new content is injected before the user perceives the bottom.
transition_observation: Before a reliable Subscribe click could be completed, the scoped demo changed from Daily Byte to Reelz; the resulting state explicitly described an endless injected-content feed.
justification: The observed cancellation/Subscribe mismatch is misleading, and the subsequent no-end-marker feed is an explicit engagement trap that removes a clear stopping point.
condition_ledger: cancellation heading conflicts with Subscribe action

visual_observation: Rendered account-settings card for a Pro member with a single Delete account action and a visible interaction-count comparison.
dom_observation: The scoped DOM states Step 0 of 7, N(x_delete) = 7 interactions, and N(x_create) = 2; Delete account is the only visible button.
transition_observation: Clicking the in-scope Delete account button produced no rendered transition; the DOM remained at Step 0 of 7.
justification: The interface explicitly requires seven delete interactions versus two create interactions, demonstrating asymmetric obstruction of account deletion.

visual_observation: Rendered a straightforward newsletter-signup offer with a one-time discount and two visible choices.
dom_observation: The scoped DOM states Get 10% off your first order, describes weekly tips plus a one-time discount code, and exposes Yes, claim my 10% discount and No, thanks as separate buttons.
transition_observation: Clicking the in-scope No, thanks option produced no rendered transition; both explicit choices remained visible.
justification: The offer and benefit are clearly stated, and opting out is directly available as an explicit No, thanks action without an observed obstruction.

visual_observation: Rendered SwiftDrop free-plan download card with a separate feature-upgrade card and no visible restriction on the free download.
dom_observation: The scoped DOM states full speed, clean exports, and that the free download is not throttled or watermarked; the paid plan offers 2 TB storage, auto-sync, and priority support as extra features.
transition_observation: Clicking the in-scope Download (free plan) button produced no rendered DOM change; the free state remained visible at 0% with the button enabled.
justification: The free plan preserves core functionality and the paid plan adds optional features rather than removing access or selling relief from engineered restrictions.

visual_observation: Rendered a simple AeroSound X9 product card with a clear dollar price, product description, and Add to Cart control.
dom_observation: The scoped DOM describes over-ear noise-cancelling headphones with 40h battery, states free returns within 30 days, shows $129.99, and exposes Add to Cart.
transition_observation: Clicking the in-scope Add to Cart button produced no rendered DOM change; the product card remained unchanged.
justification: The product, price, return policy, and purchase action are plainly disclosed with no observed coercive or obstructive condition.
